metrics_scope.joint_effort: All physics samples including terminal censored tail, plus separately complete cycles. Group RMS pools joints and time. Percentiles are of abs torque/velocity. Adjacent changes exclude resets. Applied PD drive torque excludes passive impact loading. Hard saturation tolerance 1e-4 Nm; speed reporting tolerances foot 10.01, leg/shank20.01, wheel33.01 rad/s are descriptive, not approved acceptance thresholds.
metrics_scope.motion: Complete successful frame-zero cycles only. Wheel X gap is axle-centre difference projected onto current base X. Hip-wheel length difference is right distance minus left distance. Contact Fz threshold10 N only defines reporting support; longest contact loss is inferred support, not calibrated flight. Phase masks use reference frames, and actual events are separately recorded. Mechanical power=sum(abs(applied_torque*joint_velocity)), excludes electrical losses.

training.interpretation: Training aggregates; changed rewards and randomization prevent raw reward or single-change causal conclusions.
